qe: What does LAMA stand for in hospital discharge procedures?
qh: अस्पताल की छुट्टी की प्रक्रिया में LAMA का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Leave Against Medical Advice | सलाह के विरुद्ध छोड़ना
e: LAMA refers to a patient choosing to leave the hospital despite the doctor's recommendation to stay for treatment.

qe: Which site is most commonly used to assess the pulse in an adult during a routine checkup?
qh: नियमित जांच के दौरान वयस्क में पल्स मापने के लिए किस स्थान का सबसे अधिक उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: The radial artery at the wrist is the most common site for assessing pulse rate. It is easy to reach, lies over the bone and can be felt with two fingers; the count is taken for a full minute when the rhythm is irregular.

qe: What is the normal range for adult body temperature measured orally?
qh: मौखिक रूप से मापे गए वयस्क शरीर के तापमान की सामान्य सीमा क्या है?
e: 98.6°F is considered the standard normal body temperature for a healthy adult. The normal range is about 97 to 99 degrees Fahrenheit, and it is a little lower in the morning and higher in the evening.

qe: What is 'Autonomy' in nursing ethics?
qh: नर्सिंग नैतिकता में 'स्वायत्तता' (Autonomy) क्या है?
o: The patient's right to make their own decisions | निर्णय लेने का रोगी का अधिकार
e: Autonomy respects the patient's right to self-determination regarding their medical care. The nurse must take informed consent and respect the patient's choice even when it differs from the staff's opinion.

qe: The principle of 'Beneficence' means:
qh: 'बेनिफिशेंस' (Beneficence) के सिद्धांत का अर्थ है:
o: Doing good and acting in the patient's best interest | रोगी के हित में कार्य करना
e: Beneficence requires nurses to take positive actions to help others and ensure patient safety.

qe: What is 'Non-maleficence'?
qh: 'नॉन-मलेफिशेंस' (Non-maleficence) क्या है?
o: Duty to do no harm | हानि न पहुँचाने का कर्तव्य
e: This core principle dictates that a nurse must avoid actions that intentionally cause harm to the patient.

qe: What is 'Professional Etiquette' in nursing?
qh: नर्सिंग में 'पेशेवर शिष्टाचार' (Professional Etiquette) क्या है?
o: Rules for polite and professional behavior | विनम्र और पेशेवर व्यवहार के नियम
e: Etiquette includes proper communication, respect for colleagues, and maintaining professional boundaries.

qe: In legal terms, 'Negligence' refers to:
qh: कानूनी शब्दों में, 'लापरवाही' (Negligence) का तात्पर्य है:
o: Failure to provide a standard level of care | देखभाल के मानक स्तर में विफलता
e: Negligence occurs when a nurse's conduct falls below the expected professional standard, leading to injury.

qe: What is 'Confidentiality'?
qh: 'गोपनीयता' (Confidentiality) क्या है?
o: Protecting the patient's private information | रोगी की निजी जानकारी की रक्षा करना
e: Patient information should only be shared with the healthcare team directly involved in their care.

qe: What is 'Informed Consent'?
qh: 'सूचित सहमति' (Informed Consent) क्या है?
o: Asking the patient to sign a blank paper
Agreement after understanding the risks and benefits | जोखिम और लाभ समझने के बाद सहमति
e: Consent must be voluntary and based on a full understanding of the procedure or treatment.

qe: What is the primary responsibility of a nurse toward a dying patient?
qh: मरते हुए रोगी के प्रति नर्स की प्राथमिक जिम्मेदारी क्या है?
o: Providing comfort, dignity, and symptom management | आराम, गरिमा और लक्षण प्रबंधन
e: End-of-life care focuses on quality of life and supporting the patient and family emotionally.

qe: The term 'Fidelity' in ethics refers to:
qh: नैतिकता में 'फिडेलिटी' (Fidelity) शब्द का तात्पर्य है:
o: Being faithful and keeping promises | वफादार होना और वादे निभाना
e: Fidelity involves loyalty and fulfilling professional obligations to the patient. It means keeping promises, following the plan of care and never abandoning the patient.

qe: What is 'Veracity'?
qh: 'वेरासिटी' (Veracity) क्या है?
o: Truth-telling and honesty | सच बोलना और ईमानदारी
e: Veracity is essential for building a trusting relationship between the nurse and the patient.

qe: What is 'Parenteral' nutrition?
qh: 'पैरेंट्रल' (Parenteral) पोषण क्या है?
o: Nutrition given intravenously (via IV) | नसों के माध्यम से पोषण
e: It is used when the digestive system cannot absorb nutrients or must be bypassed. The nutrients are given through a vein, and the solution contains glucose, amino acids, fats, vitamins and minerals.

qe: Which electrolyte imbalance is called 'Hyperkalemia'?
qh: किस इलेक्ट्रोलाइट असंतुलन को 'हाइपरकेलेमिया' कहा जाता है?
e: Hyperkalemia can cause serious heart rhythm problems and is a medical emergency. The potassium level rises above about 5.5 mEq per litre, and a high intake, kidney failure or breakdown of blood cells can cause it.

qe: What is the calorie value of 1 gram of 'Protein'?
qh: 1 ग्राम 'प्रोटीन' का कैलोरी मान क्या है?
e: Both carbohydrates and proteins provide 4 kcal per gram, while fats provide 9 kcal. The body uses protein for growth and repair, and any extra is burnt for energy or stored as fat.

qe: A patient with NG tube feeding should be kept in which position to prevent aspiration?
qh: एस्पिरेशन रोकने के लिए NG ट्यूब फीडिंग वाले मरीज को किस स्थिति में रखना चाहिए?
e: Elevating the head of the bed prevents stomach contents from flowing back into the lungs. The patient is propped up during the feed and for about half an hour after it, and the leftover gastric volume is checked before the next feed.

qe: Which mineral imbalance is the primary cause of 'Tetany'?
qh: 'टेटनी' (Tetany) का प्राथमिक कारण किस खनिज का असंतुलन है?
e: Hypocalcemia causes over-excitability of nerves and muscles, leading to cramps and tetany.

qe: A person with a BMI score of 30 or above is considered:
qh: 30 या उससे अधिक BMI स्कोर वाले व्यक्ति को माना जाता है:
e: A BMI of 18.5-24.9 is normal; 25-29.9 is overweight; and 30+ is obese. A BMI between 30 and 34.9 is class I obesity, and higher values carry a greater risk of diabetes and heart disease.

qe: What is 'Respiratory Acidosis' typically caused by?
qh: 'रेस्पिरेटरी एसिडोसिस' आमतौर पर किसके कारण होता है?
e: When lungs cannot remove enough CO2, the blood becomes too acidic. It is seen in COPD, chest injury or shallow breathing, and the pH of the blood falls below the normal range.

qe: Which nutrient should be restricted in a patient with 'Hepatic Encephalopathy'?
qh: 'हिपेटिक एन्सेफैलोपैथी' के रोगी में किस पोषक तत्व को सीमित किया जाना चाहिए?
e: Protein breakdown produces ammonia; reducing protein helps prevent ammonia buildup in the brain.

qe: What is the purpose of 'Gavage' feeding?
qh: 'गैवेज' (Gavage) फीडिंग का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Giving liquid nourishment via a tube to the stomach | ट्यूब से भोजन देना
e: Gavage is used for patients who cannot swallow, like premature infants or unconscious adults.

qe: Which electrolyte is mainly found in 'Extracellular Fluid' (ECF)?
qh: 'एक्स्ट्रासेलुलर फ्लूइड' (ECF) में मुख्य रूप से कौन सा इलेक्ट्रोलाइट पाया जाता है?
e: Sodium is the primary cation of the ECF, while Potassium is primary in the Intracellular Fluid.

qe: Which vitamin is also known as the 'Sunshine Vitamin'?
qh: किस विटामिन को 'सनशाइन विटामिन' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
e: The body produces Vitamin D when the skin is exposed to sunlight. It is needed for the absorption of calcium, and its deficiency causes rickets in children and bone pain in adults.

qe: What is the main function of 'Vitamin K'?
qh: 'विटामिन K' का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
e: Vitamin K is essential for the synthesis of proteins needed for blood clotting. It is a fat-soluble vitamin, and newborns are given an injection of it to prevent bleeding.

qe: Which mineral deficiency is linked to 'Goitre' (swelling of thyroid)?
qh: किस खनिज की कमी 'घेंघा' (Goitre) से जुड़ी है?
e: Iodine is required for thyroid hormone production; its lack causes thyroid enlargement. The gland enlarges in order to trap more iodine, and the use of iodised salt prevents this.

qe: What is 'Anorexia'?
qh: 'एनोरेक्सिया' (Anorexia) क्या है?
o: Loss of appetite | भूख न लगना
e: Anorexia can be a symptom of illness or a psychological eating disorder. It means loss of appetite, and it may be due to fever, infection, stress or a serious disease.

qe: Which diet is recommended for a patient with 'Peptic Ulcer'?
qh: 'पेप्टिक अल्सर' के रोगी के लिए कौन सा आहार अनुशंसित है?
e: A bland diet avoids spicy, fried, and acidic foods that irritate the stomach lining. Small frequent meals, milk and non-irritating food are advised, while alcohol, smoking and tea on an empty stomach are avoided.

qe: Deficiency of 'Iron' during pregnancy primarily increases the risk of:
qh: गर्भावस्था के दौरान 'आयरन' की कमी मुख्य रूप से किसका खतरा बढ़ाती है?
e: Anemia can lead to preterm birth, low birth weight, and maternal exhaustion. Anaemia in pregnancy also raises the risk of maternal death and infection, so iron and folic acid tablets are given routinely.

qe: Which nutrient provides the most 'Calories' per gram?
qh: प्रति ग्राम सबसे अधिक 'कैलोरी' कौन सा पोषक तत्व प्रदान करता है?
e: Fats provide 9 kcal per gram, more than double that of carbs or proteins (4 kcal). Fats also carry the fat-soluble vitamins and improve the taste, but an excess leads to obesity.

qe: Which food is a rich source of 'Vitamin B12'?
qh: कौन सा भोजन 'विटामिन B12' का समृद्ध स्रोत है?
o: Animal products (Meat, Milk, Eggs) | पशु उत्पाद
e: B12 is found almost exclusively in animal-based foods; vegetarians may need supplements. It is needed for the formation of red blood cells and for the health of the nerves, and its lack causes a special type of anaemia.

qe: What is 'Clear Liquid Diet'?
qh: 'क्लियर लिक्विड डाइट' क्या है?
o: Transparent liquids like water and broth | पारदर्शी तरल पदार्थ
e: It is used post-surgery to provide fluids without stressing the digestive system. It includes water, clear soups, juice without pulp and tea, and it leaves no residue in the gut.

qe: Which vitamin deficiency leads to 'Pernicious Anemia'?
qh: किस विटामिन की कमी से 'पर्निसियस एनीमिया' होता है?
e: B12 is necessary for RBC formation; its deficiency leads to a specific type of anemia. The anaemia is called pernicious because the stomach fails to make the intrinsic factor needed to absorb the vitamin.

qe: Which blood vessel carries deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs?
qh: कौन सी रक्त वाहिका हृदय से फेफड़ों तक अशुद्ध रक्त ले जाती है?
e: Unlike other arteries, the pulmonary artery carries deoxygenated blood to the lungs for oxygenation.

qe: What is the largest organ in the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर का सबसे बड़ा अंग कौन सा है?
e: The skin is the largest organ by surface area and weight, providing protection and regulation.

qe: Which type of immunity is transferred from mother to fetus through the placenta?
qh: प्लेसेंटा के माध्यम से माँ से भ्रूण में कौन सी प्रतिरक्षा स्थानांतरित होती है?
o: Natural Passive Immunity | प्राकृतिक निष्क्रिय प्रतिरक्षा
e: Passive immunity involves the transfer of pre-formed antibodies (IgG) from mother to baby.

qe: What is the function of 'Platelets' in the blood?
qh: रक्त में 'प्लेटलेट्स' का क्या कार्य है?
o: Blood clotting | रक्त का थक्का जमना
e: Platelets (thrombocytes) are essential for stopping bleeding through the formation of clots.

qe: Which acid is naturally present in the stomach to aid digestion?
qh: पाचन में सहायता के लिए पेट में प्राकृतिक रूप से कौन सा एसिड मौजूद होता है?
e: HCl creates an acidic environment for enzymes like pepsin to break down proteins. It also kills the bacteria taken in with food and turns the inactive pepsinogen into active pepsin.

qe: The process of 'Pasteurization' is commonly used for:
qh: 'पाश्चुरीकरण' की प्रक्रिया आमतौर पर किसके लिए उपयोग की जाती है?
e: Pasteurization uses controlled heat to kill pathogens in milk and other beverages without affecting quality.

qe: Which hormone regulates the 'Sleep-Wake' cycle?
qh: कौन सा हार्मोन 'नींद-जागने' के चक्र को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Melatonin is produced by the pineal gland in response to darkness, aiding sleep. It is secreted in the dark, so working in night shifts and bright light disturb the sleep cycle.

qe: In Microbiology, 'Culture' refers to:
qh: माइक्रोबायोलॉजी में, 'कल्चर' का तात्पर्य है:
o: Growth of microorganisms in a nutrient medium | पोषक माध्यम में सूक्ष्मजीवों की वृद्धि
e: A culture is used to multiply and identify specific pathogens from clinical samples. The sample is put on a suitable medium and kept warm so that the bacteria multiply and can be identified and tested against drugs.

qe: Where does the exchange of gases occur in the lungs?
qh: फेफड़ों में गैसों का आदान-प्रदान कहाँ होता है?
e: Alveoli are tiny air sacs where oxygen enters the blood and CO2 leaves it. Their walls are very thin and are covered by capillaries, so the gases pass easily between the air and the blood.

qe: What is the normal pH of human blood?
qh: मानव रक्त का सामान्य pH क्या है?
e: Blood is slightly alkaline; maintaining this narrow pH range is vital for survival. A fall below this range is acidosis and a rise is alkalosis, and both are dangerous if not corrected.

qe: Deficiency of which Vitamin causes 'Night Blindness'?
qh: किस विटामिन की कमी से 'रतौंधी' (Night Blindness) होती है?
e: Vitamin A is essential for the production of rhodopsin, necessary for vision in low light.

qe: Which nutrient is the primary source of 'Energy' for the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर के लिए 'ऊर्जा' का प्राथमिक स्रोत कौन सा पोषक तत्व है?
e: Carbohydrates provide about 4 kcal per gram and are the body's preferred energy source. They are easily digested and used, and the brain and the red cells depend mainly on glucose.

qe: Scurvy is caused by the deficiency of:
qh: स्कर्वी (Scurvy) किसकी कमी के कारण होता है?
e: Vitamin C is vital for collagen synthesis; its lack leads to bleeding gums and skin spots.

qe: Which mineral is necessary for the formation of 'Hemoglobin'?
qh: 'हीमोग्लोबिन' के निर्माण के लिए कौन सा खनिज आवश्यक है?
e: Iron is a core component of hemoglobin, which carries oxygen in the blood. It is obtained from green leafy vegetables, liver, meat and jaggery, and vitamin C helps its absorption.

qe: What is 'Balanced Diet'?
qh: 'संतुलित आहार' क्या है?
o: Diet containing all essential nutrients in correct proportions | सभी पोषक तत्वों वाला आहार
e: A balanced diet provides proteins, fats, carbs, vitamins, and minerals required for optimal health.

qe: Which disease is caused by extreme 'Protein-Energy Malnutrition' (PEM)?
qh: 'प्रोटीन-ऊर्जा कुपोषण' (PEM) के कारण कौन सी बीमारी होती है?
o: Kwashiorkor and Marasmus | क्वाशियोरकोर और मारस्मस
e: Kwashiorkor results from protein deficiency, while Marasmus is a deficiency of total calories.

qe: What is the recommended diet for a patient with 'Hypertension'?
qh: 'उच्च रक्तचाप' के रोगी के लिए अनुशंसित आहार क्या है?
o: DASH diet (Low Sodium) | कम नमक वाला आहार
e: Reducing sodium and increasing potassium helps lower blood pressure. Salt is restricted, and fruits, vegetables, whole grains and low-fat milk are increased while fried and processed food is cut down.

qe: Rickets in children is caused by the deficiency of:
qh: बच्चों में रिकेट्स (Rickets) किसकी कमी से होता है?
e: Vitamin D is essential for calcium absorption; its deficiency leads to soft, weak bones. The bones become soft and bent, and the child may have bow legs and delayed walking; sunlight and cod liver oil prevent it.

qe: Which food group is most important for 'Tissue Repair' and growth?
qh: 'ऊतक मरम्मत' और विकास के लिए कौन सा खाद्य समूह सबसे महत्वपूर्ण है?
e: Proteins are the building blocks of the body, necessary for repairing tissues and building muscle.

qe: Which diet is prescribed for a patient with 'Chronic Kidney Disease'?
qh: 'क्रोनिक किडनी डिजीज' के रोगी के लिए कौन सा आहार निर्धारित किया जाता है?
o: Low protein and restricted potassium diet | कम प्रोटीन वाला आहार
e: Limiting protein and minerals reduces the workload on failing kidneys. Salt, potassium and phosphorus are also limited, and the fluid intake is controlled as advised.

qe: Which organ is known as the 'Powerhouse' of the cell?
qh: कोशिका का 'पावरहाउस' किस अंग को कहा जाता है?
e: Mitochondria are responsible for generating ATP, the energy currency of the cell. They use oxygen to break down glucose and release energy in the form of ATP.

qe: What is the total number of bones in an adult human body?
qh: एक वयस्क मानव शरीर में हड्डियों की कुल संख्या कितनी होती है?
e: An adult human skeleton consists of 206 bones, while infants have more bones that fuse as they grow.

qe: Which method of sterilization uses steam under pressure?
qh: दबाव में भाप का उपयोग करने वाली कीटाणुशोधन विधि कौन सी है?
e: Autoclaving (121°C for 15-20 mins) is the most reliable method for destroying all microorganisms including spores.

qe: Which part of the brain controls balance and coordination?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा हिस्सा संतुलन और समन्वय को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: The cerebellum is responsible for maintaining posture, balance, and motor coordination. It also keeps the muscle tone normal and makes the movements smooth, and its injury causes a staggering walk.

qe: What is the 'Master Gland' of the endocrine system?
qh: अंतःस्रावी तंत्र की 'मास्टर ग्रंथि' कौन सी है?
e: The pituitary gland controls the functions of many other endocrine glands. It lies at the base of the brain and controls the thyroid, the adrenals, the gonads and growth.

qe: Gram staining is used to differentiate:
qh: ग्राम स्टेनिंग का उपयोग किसे अलग करने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Gram staining identifies bacteria based on the chemical and physical properties of their cell walls.

qe: Which gas is used for chemical sterilization of heat-sensitive items?
qh: गर्मी के प्रति संवेदनशील वस्तुओं के रासायनिक कीटाणुशोधन के लिए किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Ethylene Oxide (ETO) is widely used for sterilizing surgical instruments and plastics that cannot withstand heat.

qe: The structural and functional unit of the kidney is:
qh: गुर्दे की संरचनात्मक और कार्यात्मक इकाई है:
e: Nephrons filter the blood and form urine. Each kidney has about a million nephrons, and each one has a filtering part and a tubule.

qe: Which type of microorganism causes 'Malaria'?
qh: किस प्रकार का सूक्ष्मजीव 'मलेरिया' का कारण बनता है?
e: Malaria is caused by the Plasmodium parasite, a type of protozoa transmitted by mosquitoes.

qe: What is the full form of 'NRHM'?
qh: 'NRHM' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: National Rural Health Mission | राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण स्वास्थ्य मिशन
e: NRHM was launched to provide accessible, affordable, and quality health care to the rural population.

qe: Who is the 'Village Level' health worker under NRHM?
qh: NRHM के तहत 'ग्राम स्तर' का स्वास्थ्य कार्यकर्ता कौन है?
e: Accredited Social Health Activists (ASHA) act as a bridge between the community and the health system.

qe: What is 'ORS' therapy primarily used for in the community?
qh: समुदाय में 'ORS' थेरेपी मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए उपयोग की जाती है?
o: Rehydration in Diarrhea | डायरिया में पुनर्जलीकरण
e: Oral Rehydration Salts are used to prevent and treat dehydration caused by diarrhea. It replaces the water and salts lost in loose motions, and it is given in small sips at short intervals.

qe: What is the 'Eligible Couple' in family planning?
qh: परिवार नियोजन में 'योग्य जोड़ा' (Eligible Couple) क्या है?
o: Married couple where the woman is in the reproductive age (15-45) | प्रजनन आयु वाला जोड़ा
e: Eligible couples are those who are currently in the reproductive age group and need family planning services.

qe: Which organization is responsible for the 'Mid-day Meal' program globally?
qh: वैश्विक स्तर पर 'मिड-डे मील' कार्यक्रम के लिए कौन सा संगठन जिम्मेदार है?
e: Organizations like UNICEF and World Food Programme support nutritional initiatives for children.

qe: What is the primary sign of 'Filaria' in the chronic stage?
qh: पुराने चरण में 'फाइलेरिया' (Filaria) का प्राथमिक लक्षण क्या है?
o: Elephantiasis (Swelling of limbs) | हाथीपाँव (पैरों की सूजन)
e: Lymphatic Filariasis leads to chronic swelling, most commonly in the legs and scrotum. The swelling is due to the blockage of the lymph channels, and the limb slowly becomes hard and thick.

qe: What is 'Demography'?
qh: 'जनसांख्यिकी' (Demography) क्या है?
o: Scientific study of human populations | मानव जनसंख्या का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन
e: It involves the study of population size, structure, distribution, and changes over time. It covers the census of births, deaths and migration, and it is used to plan the health services.

qe: Which vaccine is administered as a 'Subcutaneous' injection for Measles?
qh: खसरे के लिए किस टीके को 'सबक्यूटिनियस' इंजेक्शन के रूप में लगाया जाता है?
e: The measles vaccine is typically given subcutaneously in the right upper arm. It is given into the right upper arm, and it must be stored and used as the cold chain demands.

qe: What is the 'Pre-pathogenesis' period?
qh: 'प्री-पैथोजेनेसिस' (Pre-pathogenesis) अवधि क्या है?
o: Process before the disease agent enters the human host | शरीर में प्रवेश से पहले की प्रक्रिया
e: It is the period where the interaction between the agent, host, and environment occurs before the disease begins.

qe: Which index is used to measure the 'Obesity' in a community survey?
qh: सामुदायिक सर्वेक्षण में 'मोटापा' मापने के लिए किस सूचकांक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: BMI is a simple index of weight-for-height that is commonly used to classify underweight, overweight, and obesity.

qe: What is the 'Incubation Period' of Measles?
qh: खसरे (Measles) की 'इनक्यूबेशन अवधि' क्या है?
e: The incubation period for measles typically ranges from 10 to 14 days from exposure to the onset of fever.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Zoonotic' disease?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक 'ज़ूनोटिक' (Zoonotic) बीमारी है?
e: Zoonotic diseases are those that are transmitted from animals to humans, such as Rabies via animal bites.

qe: What is the primary mode of transmission for 'Hepatitis A'?
qh: 'हेपेटाइटिस A' के संचरण का प्राथमिक तरीका क्या है?
e: Hepatitis A is primarily spread through contaminated food and water (fecal-oral route). It passes from the stool of an infected person through unsafe water, food and unwashed hands.

qe: In Epidemiology, what does 'Pandemic' refer to?
qh: महामारी विज्ञान में, 'पैंडेमिक' (Pandemic) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Worldwide spread of a new disease | विश्वव्यापी प्रसार
e: A pandemic is an epidemic occurring worldwide, or over a very wide area, crossing international boundaries.

qe: Which diagnostic test is used for 'Typhoid' fever?
qh: 'टाइफाइड' बुखार के लिए किस नैदानिक परीक्षण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: The Widal test measures agglutinating antibodies against Salmonella typhi in the patient's serum.

qe: What is 'Chemoprophylaxis'?
qh: 'कीमोप्रोफिलैक्सिस' (Chemoprophylaxis) क्या है?
o: Administration of drugs to prevent the onset of a disease | बीमारी रोकने के लिए दवा देना
e: It involves giving medications to healthy individuals to prevent them from developing a specific infection.

qe: Which vitamin deficiency is specifically targeted in the national prophylaxis program to prevent blindness?
qh: अंधापन रोकने के लिए राष्ट्रीय कार्यक्रम में किस विटामिन की कमी को लक्षित किया गया है?
e: Massive doses of Vitamin A are given to children to prevent Xerophthalmia and nutritional blindness.

qe: What is the main vector for 'Kala-azar'?
qh: 'काला-अजार' का मुख्य वाहक (Vector) क्या है?
e: Kala-azar (Visceral Leishmaniasis) is transmitted by the bite of infected female phlebotomine sandflies.

qe: Which level of prevention includes 'Early Diagnosis and Prompt Treatment'?
qh: 'शीघ्र निदान और तत्काल उपचार' बचाव के किस स्तर में शामिल है?
e: Secondary prevention focuses on early detection of disease and intervention to prevent complications.

qe: What is the causative agent of 'Syphilis'?
qh: 'सिफलिस' का कारण बनने वाला एजेंट कौन सा है?
e: Syphilis is a sexually transmitted infection caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum. It spreads by sexual contact and from mother to child, and it is treated with penicillin.

qe: What is the 'Window Period' in HIV infection?
qh: HIV संक्रमण में 'विंडो पीरियड' क्या है?
o: Time between infection and appearance of antibodies | संक्रमण और एंटीबॉडी के बीच का समय
e: During this period, a person is infected but the blood test may show a negative result. It may last a few weeks, so a negative report during this period does not rule out the infection.

qe: Which test is used for the screening of 'HIV'?
qh: 'HIV' की स्क्रीनिंग के लिए किस टेस्ट का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: ELISA is the primary screening test, followed by Western Blot for confirmation. A reactive sample is tested again by two different tests, and every report is kept strictly confidential.

qe: What is the mode of transmission for 'Malaria'?
qh: 'मलेरिया' के संचरण का तरीका क्या है?
o: Bite of infected Female Anopheles mosquito | मादा एनाफिलीज मच्छर का काटना
e: The parasite Plasmodium is injected into the bloodstream via the mosquito's saliva. The mosquito bites between dusk and dawn, and the parasite first multiplies in the liver and then in the red cells.

qe: In Epidemiology, what does 'Endemic' mean?
qh: महामारी विज्ञान में, 'एंडेमिक' (Endemic) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Constant presence of a disease in a specific area | किसी क्षेत्र में बीमारी की निरंतर उपस्थिति
e: An endemic disease is always present at a baseline level in a particular population or region.

qe: Which is the drug of choice for 'Cholera' to reduce the duration of illness?
qh: बीमारी की अवधि कम करने के लिए 'हैजा' की दवा कौन सी है?
e: While ORS is primary for hydration, antibiotics help clear the Vibrio cholerae bacteria faster.

qe: What is the 'DOTS' strategy used for?
qh: 'DOTS' रणनीति का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
e: Directly Observed Treatment, Short-course ensures patient compliance for TB treatment. A health worker watches the patient swallow every dose, which prevents missed doses and the rise of drug resistance.

qe: Which organization provides global leadership in public health?
qh: सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य में वैश्विक नेतृत्व कौन सा संगठन प्रदान करता है?
e: WHO sets international health standards and monitors global disease outbreaks. It fixes international health standards, gives technical help to countries and reports outbreaks of disease.

qe: What is the 'Cold Chain' system?
qh: 'कोल्ड चेन' (Cold Chain) सिस्टम क्या है?
o: System of transporting and storing vaccines at low temperatures | टीकों के भंडारण की व्यवस्था
e: It is critical for maintaining the potency of temperature-sensitive vaccines. The vaccine is kept at the right temperature from the factory to the child, using refrigerators, vaccine carriers and ice packs.

qe: Which symptom is characteristic of 'Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever'?
qh: 'डेंगू रक्तस्रावी बुखार' का विशिष्ट लक्षण क्या है?
o: Decrease in platelet count and bleeding | प्लेटलेट काउंट में कमी
e: Thrombocytopenia (low platelets) leads to severe bleeding risks in dengue patients. The bleeding may start from the nose, gums or gut, and the patient may go into shock.

qe: What is 'Quarantine'?
qh: 'क्वारंटाइन' (Quarantine) क्या है?
o: Restriction of movement for healthy people exposed to infection | स्वस्थ लोगों की आवाजाही पर प्रतिबंध
e: Quarantine is for people who were exposed but are not yet showing symptoms, unlike isolation for the sick.

qe: What is the 'Primary' level of prevention?
qh: बचाव का 'प्राथमिक' (Primary) स्तर क्या है?
o: Health promotion and specific protection | स्वास्थ्य संवर्धन और विशिष्ट सुरक्षा
e: Primary prevention aims to prevent the onset of disease through measures like immunization and nutrition.

qe: Which method is most effective for disinfecting water at the household level?
qh: घरेलू स्तर पर पानी को कीटाणुमुक्त करने के लिए कौन सी विधि सबसे प्रभावी है?
e: Boiling water is the simplest and most effective way to kill pathogenic microorganisms. The water is boiled for a few minutes and then cooled and stored in a clean covered pot.

qe: What is the main objective of 'Health Education'?
qh: 'स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा' का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To change people's behavior towards healthy living | व्यवहार में बदलाव
e: Health education empowers individuals to take responsibility for their own health through informed choices.

qe: Which vector is responsible for spreading 'Dengue' fever?
qh: 'डेंगू' बुखार फैलाने के लिए कौन सा वाहक जिम्मेदार है?
o: Aedes aegypti mosquito | एडीज इजिप्टी मच्छर
e: Aedes aegypti is a day-biting mosquito that transmits the dengue virus. It breeds in clean stagnant water in pots, tyres and coolers, and it bites during the day.

qe: The concept of 'Social Distance' is primarily used to control:
qh: 'सोशल डिस्टेंस' की अवधारणा मुख्य रूप से किसे नियंत्रित करने के लिए उपयोग की जाती है?
e: Physical distancing prevents the spread of pathogens through respiratory droplets or direct contact.

qe: What is 'Epidemiology'?
qh: 'महामारी विज्ञान' (Epidemiology) क्या है?
o: Study of the distribution and determinants of diseases | बीमारियों के वितरण का अध्ययन
e: It is the fundamental science of public health used to identify risk factors and disease patterns.

qe: Which gas is primarily responsible for 'Global Warming'?
qh: 'ग्लोबल वार्मिंग' के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी गैस जिम्मेदार है?
e: CO2 acts as a greenhouse gas, trapping heat in the Earth's atmosphere. It is released by burning fuels, and its rising level traps heat and changes the climate.

qe: What is the ideal 'Incubation Period' of Cholera?
qh: हैजा (Cholera) की आदर्श 'इनक्यूबेशन अवधि' क्या है?
o: A few hours to 5 days | कुछ घंटे से 5 दिन
e: Cholera has a very short incubation period, leading to rapid outbreaks. It varies from a few hours to about five days, and the patient may pass rice-water stools within this period.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Water-borne' disease?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी 'जल-जनित' (Water-borne) बीमारी है?
e: Typhoid fever is spread through contaminated food and water. It spreads through food and water contaminated with faecal matter, and it causes a long fever with a slow pulse.

qe: What does 'Somatic' health education focus on?
qh: 'सोमैटिक' स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा किस पर ध्यान केंद्रित करती है?
o: Physical health of the body | शरीर का भौतिक स्वास्थ्य
e: It deals with hygiene, exercise, and physical well-being. It also covers good habits, rest, posture and the prevention of injuries.

qe: What is the defining feature of 'Obsession' in OCD?
qh: OCD में 'जुनून' (Obsession) की परिभाषित विशेषता क्या है?
o: Recurrent, intrusive, and unwanted thoughts | बार-बार आने वाले अनचाहे विचार
e: Obsessions are the mental component of OCD that cause significant anxiety. It is a repeated thought, image or urge which the patient knows is his own but cannot stop.

qe: What is 'Systematic Desensitization' used for?
qh: 'सिस्टमैटिक डीसेंसिटाइजेशन' का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
e: It is a behavioral therapy where the patient is gradually exposed to the feared object while relaxed.

qe: In 'Seclusion', the nurse's primary responsibility is:
qh: 'अलगाव' (Seclusion) में नर्स की प्राथमिक जिम्मेदारी है:
o: Continuous safety monitoring and meeting basic needs | सुरक्षा निगरानी और बुनियादी जरूरतें
e: Safety and ethical care are paramount when a patient is isolated for behavioral control. The patient is watched closely at short intervals, is never left unobserved and is released as soon as the behaviour is controlled.

qe: What is 'Acrophobia'?
qh: 'एक्रोफोबिया' (Acrophobia) क्या है?
o: Fear of heights | ऊंचाई से डर
e: Acrophobia is an irrational and persistent fear of heights. The patient avoids heights, balconies and bridges, and the fear is out of proportion to the real danger.

qe: What is the focus of 'Exposure and Response Prevention' (ERP) for OCD?
qh: OCD के लिए 'एक्सपोज़र और रिस्पांस प्रिवेंशन' (ERP) का केंद्र क्या है?
o: Facing the fear without performing the ritual | बिना क्रिया किए डर का सामना करना
e: ERP helps break the cycle of anxiety by preventing the compulsive behavior used to relieve it.

qe: Which nursing intervention is best for a patient with 'Agoraphobia'?
qh: 'अगोराफोबिया' वाले मरीज के लिए कौन सा नर्सिंग हस्तक्षेप सबसे अच्छा है?
o: Gradual exposure to outdoor environments | बाहरी वातावरण का क्रमिक सामना
Keep them in a dark room
e: Gradual exposure helps the patient build confidence in spaces where they feel trapped. The patient first goes out with a trusted person and later alone, and the distance and time are increased gradually.

qe: What is 'Nyctophobia'?
qh: 'नाइक्टोफोबिया' (Nyctophobia) क्या है?
o: Fear of darkness/night | अंधेरे या रात से डर
e: It is an extreme fear of the night or darkness. It is common in children, and it may follow a frightening experience or be part of another anxiety disorder.

qe: When should 'Physical Restraints' be removed?
qh: 'शारीरिक प्रतिबंध' कब हटाए जाने चाहिए?
o: As soon as the patient is safe and regains control | जैसे ही मरीज सुरक्षित हो जाए
e: Restraints must be discontinued at the earliest possible time to protect the patient's rights.

qe: A patient with OCD spends hours washing hands. The nurse should:
qh: OCD वाला मरीज घंटों हाथ धोता है। नर्स को चाहिए:
o: Establish a structured schedule to gradually reduce time | समय को धीरे-धीरे कम करने के लिए सारणी बनाना
e: Abruptly stopping the ritual can cause severe panic; a structured approach is more therapeutic.

qe: The patient's right to 'Informed Consent' means:
qh: रोगी के 'सूचित सहमति' के अधिकार का अर्थ है:
o: Understanding risks and benefits before treatment | उपचार से पहले जोखिम और लाभ को समझना
e: Informed consent is a legal and ethical requirement ensuring the patient knows what they are agreeing to.

qe: Which therapy uses a system of 'Rewards' for good behavior?
qh: किस थेरेपी में अच्छे व्यवहार के लिए 'इनाम' की प्रणाली का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Token economy is a form of behavior modification where positive behavior is rewarded with tokens.

qe: What is 'Aversion Therapy'?
qh: 'एवर्जन थेरेपी' (Aversion Therapy) क्या है?
o: Associating an undesirable habit with an unpleasant stimulus | अवांछित आदत को अप्रिय अनुभव से जोड़ना
e: It is often used to treat alcoholism or smoking by linking the habit with something unpleasant (like a mild shock or nausea-inducing drug).

qe: In 'Psychoanalysis', who is the founder?
qh: 'मनोविश्लेषण' (Psychoanalysis) के संस्थापक कौन हैं?
e: Freud developed psychoanalysis focusing on the unconscious mind and childhood experiences.

qe: What is 'Catatonia'?
qh: 'कैटेटोनिया' (Catatonia) क्या है?
o: Abnormality of movement and behavior arising from a disturbed mental state | शारीरिक जड़ता
e: Catatonia can involve complete lack of movement (stupor) or rigid body posture for long periods.

qe: Under the Mental Healthcare Act 2017, 'Suicide' is:
qh: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य देखभाल अधिनियम 2017 के तहत, 'आत्महत्या' है:
o: Decriminalized (presumed to be under severe stress) | अपराध की श्रेणी से बाहर
e: The law now presumes that a person attempting suicide is under severe stress and should be treated, not punished.

qe: What is 'Empathy' in nursing practice?
qh: नर्सिंग अभ्यास में 'सहानुभूति' (Empathy) क्या है?
o: Understanding the patient's feelings from their perspective | रोगी की भावनाओं को उनके नजरिए से समझना
e: Empathy is a core skill in therapeutic communication where the nurse understands but remains professional.

qe: Which side effect is common with first-generation Antipsychotics?
qh: पहली पीढ़ी की एंटीसाइकोटिक्स दवाओं का सामान्य दुष्प्रभाव क्या है?
e: EPS includes muscle spasms, tremors, and restlessness (Akathisia). These effects appear early, and they are treated with anticholinergic drugs like trihexyphenidyl.

qe: What is 'Waxy Flexibility'?
qh: 'वैक्सी फ्लेक्सिबिलिटी' (Waxy Flexibility) क्या है?
o: Patient maintains a body position for a long time as if made of wax | शरीर का एक ही स्थिति में बने रहना
e: It is a sign often seen in catatonic schizophrenia. The patient keeps the limb in the position in which the examiner places it, and it is seen in catatonia.

qe: A patient feels that 'everyone is plotting against them'. This is:
qh: एक मरीज को लगता है कि 'सब उसके खिलाफ साजिश कर रहे हैं'। यह है:
o: Delusion of Persecution | उत्पीड़न का भ्रम
e: This is a common symptom in paranoid disorders where the patient is extremely suspicious. The belief is held firmly, and this symptom often makes the patient hostile or violent.

qe: What is 'Hypochondriasis'?
qh: 'हाइपोकॉन्ड्रियासिस' (Hypochondriasis) क्या है?
o: Abnormal anxiety about one's health, often believing they have a serious disease | बीमारी का काल्पनिक डर
e: The patient is preoccupied with the fear of having a serious illness despite medical reassurance.

qe: What is the primary symptom of 'Schizophrenia'?
qh: 'सिज़ोफ्रेनिया' (Schizophrenia) का प्राथमिक लक्षण क्या है?
o: Distorted thinking and social withdrawal | विकृत सोच और सामाजिक अलगाव
e: Schizophrenia is a severe mental disorder where people interpret reality abnormally, often involving delusions and hallucinations.

qe: Which of the following is a symptom of 'Alcohol Withdrawal'?
qh: 'अल्कोहल विड्रॉल' (शराब छोड़ने के लक्षण) का लक्षण कौन सा है?
o: Tremors and agitation | कंपन और घबराहट
e: Withdrawal symptoms occur when a person suddenly stops heavy drinking, leading to physical and mental distress.

qe: A patient repeats the same word or phrase again and again. This is called:
qh: एक मरीज बार-बार एक ही शब्द या वाक्यांश दोहराता है। इसे कहा जाता है:
e: Echolalia is the meaningless repetition of another person's spoken words as a symptom of a psychiatric disorder.

qe: What is 'Anorexia Nervosa'?
qh: 'एनोरेक्सिया नर्वोसा' (Anorexia Nervosa) क्या है?
o: Refusal to eat due to fear of gaining weight | वजन बढ़ने के डर से खाना न खाना
e: It is an eating disorder characterized by an abnormally low body weight and intense fear of gaining weight.

qe: Which medication is an 'Antidote' for Benzodiazepine overdose?
qh: बेंजोडायजेपाइन ओवरडोज के लिए 'एंटीडोट' कौन सा है?
e: Flumazenil is used to reverse the sedative effects of benzodiazepines in emergency cases. It is given by injection and acts within minutes, but it is used carefully in patients who have also taken an antidepressant.

qe: What is 'Pica'?
qh: 'पिका' (Pica) क्या है?
o: Eating non-food substances like mud or chalk | अखाद्य पदार्थों को खाना
e: Pica is a disorder where people eat items that have no nutritional value, like dirt, hair, or paper.

qe: What is the nurse's priority for a patient in 'Acute Mania'?
qh: 'एक्यूट मेनिया' वाले मरीज के लिए नर्स की प्राथमिकता क्या है?
o: Reducing environmental stimuli and ensuring safety | उत्तेजना को कम करना और सुरक्षा
e: Manic patients are easily overstimulated; a quiet environment helps stabilize their mood. A quiet calm place, short and clear talks, firm limits and protection from injury are the main nursing steps.

qe: A 'False sensory perception' with no real basis is:
qh: बिना किसी वास्तविक आधार के 'झूठी संवेदी धारणा' है:
e: Unlike illusion (misinterpretation), hallucination has no external stimulus at all. It may be auditory, visual, tactile or olfactory, and the auditory type is the commonest in psychiatric illness.

qe: Which vitamin deficiency is common in chronic alcoholism?
qh: पुराने शराब के सेवन में किस विटामिन की कमी आम है?
e: Thiamine deficiency can lead to Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome, a serious brain disorder. Alcohol prevents its absorption, so thiamine and other B vitamins are given to every patient with chronic alcoholism.

qe: What is 'Bulimia Nervosa'?
qh: 'बुलिमिया नर्वोसा' (Bulimia Nervosa) क्या है?
o: Binge eating followed by purging (vomiting) | अत्यधिक खाना और फिर उल्टी करना
e: It is an eating disorder where a person eats large amounts of food and then tries to get rid of it in unhealthy ways.

qe: What is 'Electroconvulsive Therapy' (ECT)?
qh: 'इलेक्ट्रोकन्वल्सिव थेरेपी' (ECT) क्या है?
o: Passing small electric currents to induce seizures | बिजली के झटके से उपचार
e: ECT is used for severe depression or schizophrenia when medications are not effective. A small current is passed for less than a second under anaesthesia to produce a fit, and a course of six to eight sittings is usual.

qe: What is a mandatory requirement before starting ECT?
qh: ECT शुरू करने से पहले एक अनिवार्य आवश्यकता क्या है?
e: The patient or their legal guardian must provide written consent after understanding the risks.

qe: Which medication class is used to treat Schizophrenia?
qh: सिज़ोफ्रेनिया के इलाज के लिए किस दवा वर्ग का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Antipsychotics help manage symptoms like delusions and hallucinations. They act by blocking dopamine in the brain and are given along with psychological and social support.

qe: In 'Cognitive Behavioral Therapy' (CBT), the focus is on:
qh: 'संज्ञानात्मक व्यवहार थेरेपी' (CBT) में ध्यान केंद्रित किया जाता है:
o: Changing negative thought patterns | नकारात्मक विचारों को बदलना
e: CBT helps patients identify and change distorted thinking that leads to emotional distress.

qe: What is the primary role of a nurse after ECT treatment?
qh: ECT उपचार के बाद नर्स की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
o: Monitoring vitals and ensuring a safe airway | वाइटल और वायुमार्ग की निगरानी
e: The patient is often confused and at risk for aspiration immediately after the procedure. The airway is kept clear, the patient is turned to one side and the vital signs are checked till fully awake.

qe: Which drug is commonly used as a 'Mood Stabilizer' in Bipolar Disorder?
qh: बाइपोलर डिसऑर्डर में 'मूड स्टेबलाइजर' के रूप में आमतौर पर किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Lithium helps prevent both manic and depressive episodes. The blood level is checked regularly because a high level is toxic, and the salt and fluid intake must be kept normal.

qe: What is 'Occupational Therapy' in psychiatry?
qh: मनोरोग में 'ऑक्यूपेशनल थेरेपी' क्या है?
o: Using meaningful activities to improve daily functioning | सार्थक गतिविधियों का उपयोग
e: It helps patients regain skills needed for independent living. It uses work such as craft, cooking and gardening to improve attention, confidence and social skills.

qe: What is 'Phobia'?
qh: 'फोबिया' (Phobia) क्या है?
o: Persistent and irrational fear of a specific object | विशिष्ट डर
e: Examples include fear of heights (acrophobia) or enclosed spaces (claustrophobia). It is an intense, irrational fear of a particular object or situation, and the patient knows that the fear is out of proportion.

qe: Which therapy involves the patient interacting with others in a group setting?
qh: किस थेरेपी में रोगी समूह में दूसरों के साथ बातचीत करता है?
e: Group therapy provides support and helps patients realize they are not alone in their struggles.

qe: The nurse-patient relationship in psychiatry should be:
qh: मनोरोग में नर्स-रोगी संबंध कैसा होना चाहिए?
o: Therapeutic and professional | चिकित्सीय और व्यावसायिक
e: A therapeutic relationship is built on trust, empathy, and professional boundaries. It is planned, time-limited and for the patient's benefit, and it excludes personal or social involvement.

qe: What is the primary characteristic of 'Depression' in a psychiatric patient?
qh: मनोरोग रोगी में 'अवसाद' (Depression) की प्राथमिक विशेषता क्या है?
o: Persistent sadness and loss of interest | लगातार उदासी और रुचि की कमी
e: Depression is characterized by anhedonia (inability to feel pleasure) and a persistent low mood.

qe: Which nursing intervention is most critical for a 'Suicidal' patient?
qh: 'आत्महत्या की प्रवृत्ति' वाले मरीज के लिए कौन सा नर्सिंग हस्तक्षेप सबसे महत्वपूर्ण है?
e: Safety is the priority; the patient must never be left alone to prevent self-harm. The patient is kept in a safe place, under close observation, and harmful items are removed from the bedside.

qe: What is 'Hallucination'?
qh: 'मतिभ्रम' (Hallucination) क्या है?
o: Perception without any external stimuli | बिना किसी बाहरी उद्दीपन के धारणा
e: Hallucination involves seeing, hearing, or feeling things that are not actually present. The nurse should not agree with the false perception but should reassure the patient and report the symptom.

qe: A patient believes they are a 'King' despite evidence to the contrary. This is called:
qh: एक मरीज खुद को 'राजा' मानता है। इसे क्या कहा जाता है?
o: Delusion of Grandeur | भव्यता का भ्रम (Delusion)
e: Delusion is a fixed, false belief that is not shaken by logic or evidence. The belief is fixed and cannot be corrected by proof, and it is a common symptom of schizophrenia and mania.

qe: Which of the following is a sign of 'Abnormal' behavior?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'असामान्य' व्यवहार का संकेत है?
o: Social withdrawal and self-neglect | सामाजिक अलगाव और खुद की उपेक्षा
e: Abnormal behavior often interferes with daily functioning and social relationships. It is judged against the person's culture, age and situation, and it may harm the patient or others.

qe: What is 'Anxiety'?
qh: 'चिंता' (Anxiety) क्या है?
o: A feeling of apprehension or dread | घबराहट या डर की भावना
e: Anxiety is an emotional response to a perceived or real threat, often accompanied by physical symptoms.

qe: In 'Mania', the patient typically shows:
qh: 'मेनिया' (Mania) में, रोगी आमतौर पर क्या दिखाता है?
o: Elated mood and flight of ideas | उत्साहित मूड और विचारों की तेजी
e: Mania is the opposite of depression, characterized by excessive activity and euphoria. The patient talks fast, sleeps little, spends recklessly and becomes irritable when stopped.

qe: What should a nurse do first if a patient expresses suicidal thoughts?
qh: यदि कोई मरीज आत्मघाती विचार व्यक्त करता है तो नर्स को सबसे पहले क्या करना चाहिए?
o: Take it seriously and assess the plan | गंभीरता से लें और योजना का आकलन करें
e: All suicidal threats must be taken seriously and reported to the psychiatric team immediately.

qe: What is 'Illusion'?
qh: 'इल्यूजन' (Illusion) क्या है?
o: Misinterpretation of a real external stimulus | वास्तविक उद्दीपन की गलत व्याख्या
e: Example: Seeing a rope and thinking it is a snake. The external stimulus is real, but the patient gives it a wrong meaning; this is different from a hallucination.

qe: The therapeutic environment in a psychiatric ward is often called:
qh: मनोरोग वार्ड में चिकित्सीय वातावरण को अक्सर क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Milieu therapy uses the environment to promote safety and social learning. The ward is kept calm, orderly and safe, and the daily routine and group activities are used as treatment.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Cyanotic' congenital heart disease?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'सायनोटिक' जन्मजात हृदय रोग है?
o: Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) | टेट्रालॉजी ऑफ फैलोट
e: TOF is a cyanotic heart defect where deoxygenated blood mixes with oxygenated blood, leading to a blue tint in the skin (cyanosis).

qe: What is the hallmark sign of 'Kwashiorkor' that distinguishes it from Marasmus?
qh: क्वाशियोरकोर का प्रमुख लक्षण क्या है जो इसे मारस्मस से अलग करता है?
e: Kwashiorkor is primarily a protein deficiency causing fluid retention (edema), whereas Marasmus is overall calorie deficiency causing severe wasting.

qe: What is 'Play Therapy' in a hospital setting?
qh: अस्पताल सेटिंग में 'प्ले थेरेपी' (Play Therapy) क्या है?
o: Using play to help children express feelings and cope with illness | खेल के माध्यम से तनाव कम करना
e: Play therapy is a therapeutic approach used by nurses to reduce a child's anxiety and help them understand medical procedures.

qe: In 'Tetralogy of Fallot', what should a nurse do during a 'Cyanotic/Tet Spell'?
qh: TOF में, 'सायनोटिक स्पेल' के दौरान नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए?
o: Place the child in Knee-Chest position | घुटने-छाती (Knee-Chest) स्थिति में रखें
e: The knee-chest position increases systemic vascular resistance, improving blood flow to the lungs during a spell.

qe: Which condition is characterized by a 'Moon Face' appearance in children?
qh: बच्चों में 'मून फेस' (Moon Face) किस स्थिति की विशेषता है?
e: In Kwashiorkor, edema and fatty liver can give the face a rounded, 'moon-like' appearance.

qe: The 'Right to Protection from Abuse' falls under:
qh: 'दुर्व्यवहार से सुरक्षा का अधिकार' किसके अंतर्गत आता है?
e: The UN Convention on the Rights of the Child ensures that every child is protected from all forms of physical or mental violence.

qe: What is the primary nursing goal for a child with 'Spina Bifida' before surgery?
qh: सर्जरी से पहले 'स्पाइना बिफिडा' वाले बच्चे के लिए प्राथमिक नर्सिंग लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Protecting the sac from injury and infection | सैक को चोट और संक्रमण से बचाना
e: Preventing rupture of the protruding sac is vital to avoid life-threatening meningitis. The child is nursed prone, the sac is covered with a sterile wet dressing and the genital area is kept clean to prevent infection.

qe: Which type of play is typical for 'Infants'?
qh: 'शिशुओं' के लिए किस प्रकार का खेल विशिष्ट है?
e: Infants usually play alone (solitary) and are not interested in playing with other children yet.

qe: In 'Marasmus', the child has an appearance often described as:
qh: 'मारस्मस' में बच्चे का रूप अक्सर किस तरह वर्णित किया जाता है?
o: Old man's face (Wizened) | बूढ़े व्यक्ति जैसा चेहरा
e: Due to extreme loss of subcutaneous fat and muscle, the skin hangs loose, making the child look like an old person.

qe: What is the focus of a 'Child Guidance Clinic' (CGC)?
qh: 'चाइल्ड गाइडेंस क्लिनिक' (CGC) का केंद्र क्या है?
o: Preventive, curative, and rehabilitative mental health services | मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवाएं
e: CGCs address emotional, behavioral, and learning problems in children through a team of specialists.

qe: At what age does a child typically start 'Parallel Play'?
qh: एक बच्चा आमतौर पर किस उम्र में 'समानांतर खेल' (Parallel Play) शुरू करता है?
e: Toddlers often play side-by-side with other children but not directly with them. It usually appears between two and three years, and it shows that the child is beginning to notice other children.

qe: Which vaccine provides protection against 'Whooping Cough' (Pertussis)?
qh: कौन सा टीका 'काली खांसी' (Pertussis) से सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है?
e: Pertussis is the 'P' component of the DPT vaccine. It is given in three primary doses with a booster, and it may cause mild fever and pain at the site.

qe: What is the most common cause of 'Accidental Poisoning' in toddlers?
qh: टॉडलर्स में 'आकस्मिक विषाक्तता' का सबसे सामान्य कारण क्या है?
o: Unsafe storage of household chemicals | रसायनों का असुरक्षित भंडारण
e: Toddlers are curious and often ingest colorful medicines or chemicals kept within reach. Medicines, kerosene, phenyl and toilet cleaners kept within reach are the usual causes, so such items must be locked away.

qe: A child who can 'run, climb stairs, and use 2-3 word sentences' is likely:
qh: एक बच्चा जो 'दौड़ सकता है, सीढ़ियां चढ़ सकता है और 2-3 शब्दों के वाक्य बोल सकता है' वह लगभग है:
e: These are typical developmental milestones for a two-year-old toddler. By two years the child also runs, kicks a ball, sorts shapes and follows simple instructions.

qe: Which immunization is given as a 'Booster' dose at 16-24 months?
qh: 16-24 महीने की उम्र में 'बूस्टर' खुराक के रूप में कौन सा टीकाकरण दिया जाता है?
o: DPT and OPV Booster | डीपीटी और ओपीवी बूस्टर
e: Booster doses are vital to maintain immunity levels established by primary doses. The first booster of DPT and OPV is given at 16 to 24 months to keep the protection strong.

qe: What is the significance of the 'Growth Chart'?
qh: 'ग्रोथ चार्ट' का क्या महत्व है?
o: To monitor a child's growth over time and detect malnutrition | वृद्धि की निगरानी
e: It helps health workers identify deviations from normal growth patterns early. The weight of the child is plotted month by month, and a falling line warns of malnutrition or illness in time.

qe: Which position should a baby be placed in for 'Sleep' to prevent SIDS?
qh: SIDS को रोकने के लिए बच्चे को 'सोने' के लिए किस पोजीशन में रखा जाना चाहिए?
o: On the back (Supine) | पीठ के बल
e: Back-to-sleep is the safest position recommended to reduce the risk of Sudden Infant Death Syndrome.

qe: A deficiency of 'Vitamin A' in children can lead to:
qh: बच्चों में 'विटामिन A' की कमी से क्या हो सकता है?
e: Vitamin A is crucial for vision; chronic deficiency can lead to permanent blindness. It also lowers resistance to infection, and night blindness is an early sign of its deficiency.

qe: What is 'Failure to Thrive' (FTT)?
qh: 'फेलियर टू थ्राइव' (FTT) क्या है?
o: Inadequate weight gain or growth in children | अपर्याप्त शारीरिक वृद्धि
e: FTT can be due to medical issues, poor nutrition, or psychosocial neglect. It means the weight or height is far below the expected for the age, and the cause is looked for in feeding, illness and home care.

qe: What is the primary role of a 'School Health Nurse'?
qh: 'स्कूल हेल्थ नर्स' की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
o: Screening for health problems and health education | स्वास्थ्य स्क्रीनिंग
e: They ensure children are healthy, immunized, and educated about personal hygiene. She also helps to detect defects of vision, hearing and teeth early and refers the children for treatment.

qe: What is the primary sign of 'Respiratory Distress Syndrome' (RDS) in a newborn?
qh: नवजात शिशु में 'रेस्पिरेटरी डिस्ट्रेस सिंड्रोम' (RDS) का प्राथमिक लक्षण क्या है?
o: Nasal flaring and chest retractions | नाक फूलना और छाती का धंसना
e: RDS is common in preterm babies due to lack of surfactant, causing labored breathing and grunting.

qe: Which condition is a surgical emergency characterized by 'Current Jelly' stools?
qh: 'करंट जेली' जैसे मल वाली कौन सी सर्जिकल इमरजेंसी बच्चों में देखी जाती है?
e: Intussusception occurs when one part of the intestine slides into another, causing obstruction and bloody mucus in stools.

qe: What is the immediate nursing action for a child having a 'Febrile Seizure'?
qh: 'फेब्राइल सीजर' (बुखार वाले दौरे) के दौरान नर्स की तत्काल कार्रवाई क्या है?
o: Ensure safety and side-lying position | सुरक्षा और साइड-लाइंग पोजीशन
e: Protecting the child from injury and maintaining a patent airway is the priority during a seizure.

qe: Which vitamin is given at birth to prevent 'Hemorrhagic Disease' of the newborn?
qh: नवजात के 'रक्तस्रावी रोग' को रोकने के लिए जन्म के समय कौन सा विटामिन दिया जाता है?
e: Newborns have low vitamin K levels; an injection is given to ensure proper blood clotting.

qe: In a child with 'Dehydration', which sign indicates 'Severe' dehydration?
qh: 'निर्जलीकरण' (Dehydration) वाले बच्चे में कौन सा लक्षण 'गंभीर' स्थिति को दर्शाता है?
o: Sunken fontanelle and skin tenting | धंसा हुआ फोंटानेल
e: Severe dehydration is a medical emergency that leads to lethargy and electrolyte imbalance.

qe: What is the primary treatment for 'Physiological Jaundice' in newborns?
qh: नवजात शिशुओं में 'शारीरिक पीलिया' का प्राथमिक उपचार क्या है?
e: Increased feeding promotes bowel movements, helping the baby excrete bilirubin. Frequent breastfeeding helps to pass the bilirubin out in the stool and urine, and the baby is kept warm and watched.

qe: What is 'Cleft Lip'?
qh: 'क्लिफ्ट लिप' (Cleft Lip) क्या है?
o: A congenital split in the upper lip | ऊपरी होंठ में जन्मजात दरार
e: It is a congenital anomaly that requires surgical repair and specialized feeding techniques.

qe: Which positioning is best for an infant with 'Gastroesophageal Reflux' (GER)?
qh: 'जीईआर' (GER) वाले शिशु के लिए कौन सी पोजीशन सबसे अच्छी है?
o: Upright position during and after feeding | दूध पिलाने के बाद सीधा रखना
e: Keeping the baby upright helps gravity prevent stomach contents from flowing back into the esophagus.

qe: What does a 'Positive Mantoux Test' in a child indicate?
qh: बच्चे में 'सकारात्मक मोंटू टेस्ट' क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Exposure to Mycobacterium tuberculosis | टीबी के बैक्टीरिया का संपर्क
e: It shows that the child's immune system has encountered TB bacteria, but further tests are needed for diagnosis.

qe: What is the primary role of 'Oral Rehydration Salts' (ORS)?
qh: 'ओरल रीहाइड्रेशन साल्ट्स' (ORS) की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
o: Replacing lost fluids and electrolytes | तरल और इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स की पूर्ति
e: ORS is essential for preventing death from dehydration during diarrheal diseases. It does not stop the diarrhoea but replaces the lost fluid and salts, and it is given in sips after every loose stool.

qe: At what age is the first dose of 'BCG' vaccine typically administered?
qh: 'BCG' टीके की पहली खुराक आमतौर पर किस उम्र में दी जाती है?
e: BCG is given at birth to protect the newborn against tuberculosis. It is given into the left upper arm, and it protects mainly against the severe forms of tuberculosis.

qe: Which vaccine is given via the 'Oral' route?
qh: कौन सा टीका 'मौखिक' (Oral) मार्ग से दिया जाता है?
e: OPV is administered as drops into the mouth to prevent poliomyelitis. The drops are put on the tongue, and the child is given nothing by mouth for a short while after them.

qe: What is the recommended age for the first dose of 'Measles-Rubella' (MR) vaccine?
qh: 'मिजल्स-रुबेला' (MR) टीके की पहली खुराक के लिए अनुशंसित उम्र क्या है?
e: The first dose of MR is typically given between 9 to 12 completed months. A second dose is given at 16 to 24 months in the national immunisation schedule.

qe: Which vaccine is included in the 'Pentavalent' vaccine?
qh: 'पेंटावेलेंट' टीके में कौन सा टीका शामिल है?
o: DPT + Hep B + Hib | डीपीटी + हेप बी + हिब
e: Pentavalent protects against Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, and Hib. It is given as a single injection, which reduces the number of pricks and covers five serious diseases.

qe: What is 'Phototherapy' used for in newborns?
qh: नवजात शिशुओं में 'फोटोथेरेपी' का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
e: Phototherapy helps break down bilirubin in the skin so it can be excreted. The baby is kept under a special blue light with the eyes covered, and the level of bilirubin is checked at intervals.

qe: Which mineral deficiency is the most common cause of 'Anemia' in toddlers?
qh: छोटे बच्चों में 'एनीमिया' का सबसे सामान्य कारण किस खनिज की कमी है?
e: Iron deficiency anemia is prevalent in children due to rapid growth and poor dietary intake.

qe: At what age should 'Complementary Feeding' (Weaning) begin?
qh: 'पूरक आहार' (Complementary Feeding) किस उम्र में शुरू होना चाहिए?
e: After 6 months, breast milk alone is not sufficient, and solid/semi-solid foods should be introduced.

qe: What is the 'Apgar Score' used to assess?
qh: 'Apgar स्कोर' का उपयोग किसके मूल्यांकन के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Immediate physical condition of a newborn | नवजात की तत्काल स्थिति
e: It assesses heart rate, respiratory effort, muscle tone, reflex, and color at 1 and 5 minutes after birth.

qe: Which condition is a medical emergency characterized by a 'Barking Cough'?
qh: 'भौंकने वाली खांसी' (Barking Cough) किस आपातकालीन स्थिति की विशेषता है?
e: Croup is an upper airway infection that blocks breathing and has a distinctive barking cough.

qe: What is the primary role of a 'Child Guidance Clinic'?
qh: 'चाइल्ड गाइडेंस क्लिनिक' की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
o: Treating behavioral and emotional problems in children | व्यवहार संबंधी समस्याओं का उपचार
e: These clinics provide specialized help for children with developmental or psychological issues.

qe: What does the 'A' in APGAR score stand for?
qh: APGAR स्कोर में 'A' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Appearance assesses the skin color, ranging from blue/pale (0) to completely pink (2). A blue or pale body scores 0, a pink body with blue limbs scores 1 and a fully pink baby scores 2.

qe: At what intervals is the APGAR score typically assessed after birth?
qh: जन्म के बाद आमतौर पर किन अंतरालों पर APGAR स्कोर का मूल्यांकन किया जाता है?
e: The 1-minute score determines how the baby tolerated birth, and the 5-minute score tells how the baby is doing outside the womb.

qe: A newborn has a heart rate of 110 bpm, a strong cry, and some flexion of extremities. What is the APGAR score for heart rate?
qh: एक नवजात की हृदय गति 110 bpm है, वह तेजी से रो रहा है। हृदय गति के लिए APGAR स्कोर क्या है?
e: A heart rate over 100 beats per minute is assigned a maximum score of 2. A heart rate below 100 scores 1, and an absent heart beat scores 0.

qe: In Neonatal Resuscitation, what is the 'Golden Minute'?
qh: नवजात पुनर्जीवन में 'गोल्डन मिनट' क्या है?
o: First 60 seconds to start ventilation if needed | वेंटिलेशन शुरू करने के लिए पहले 60 सेकंड
Time taken to bath the baby
e: The first minute is critical for establishing breathing in a neonate who does not breathe spontaneously.

qe: What is the correct position of the head during 'Bag and Mask' ventilation?
qh: 'बैग और मास्क' वेंटिलेशन के दौरान सिर की सही स्थिति क्या है?
e: The 'sniffing' position aligns the airway for effective ventilation. The neck is slightly extended but not over-extended, and the mask covers the nose and mouth without pressing on the eyes.

qe: An APGAR score of 3 indicates that the newborn is in:
qh: 3 का APGAR स्कोर इंगित करता है कि नवजात:
o: Severe distress requiring immediate resuscitation | गंभीर संकट
e: Scores 0-3 indicate severe distress, 4-6 moderate distress, and 7-10 normal transition. Such a baby needs immediate resuscitation, warmth and close monitoring.

qe: Which sign is being assessed under 'Grimace' in the APGAR score?
qh: APGAR स्कोर में 'ग्रिमेस' (Grimace) के तहत किस संकेत का मूल्यांकन किया जाता है?
o: Reflex irritability (Response to stimulation) | रिफ्लेक्स चिड़चिड़ापन
e: Grimace evaluates the baby's response to stimulation, such as a flick to the sole of the foot.

qe: When using a Bag-Valve-Mask (Ambu Bag) on a neonate, what is the recommended ventilation rate?
qh: नवजात शिशु पर बैग-वाल्व-मास्क का उपयोग करते समय अनुशंसित वेंटिलेशन दर क्या है?
e: A rate of 40-60 breaths per minute mimics the normal respiratory rate of a newborn. The chest should be seen to rise with every squeeze of the bag, and the mask must stay sealed on the face.

qe: What is the primary indicator of successful 'Bag and Mask' ventilation?
qh: सफल 'बैग और मास्क' वेंटिलेशन का प्राथमिक संकेतक क्या है?
o: Visible chest rise | छाती का ऊपर उठना
e: Observation of the chest rising with each breath is the best sign that air is entering the lungs.

qe: If the newborn's heart rate remains below 60 bpm despite adequate ventilation, what is the next step?
qh: यदि पर्याप्त वेंटिलेशन के बावजूद नवजात की हृदय गति 60 bpm से नीचे रहती है, तो अगला कदम क्या है?
o: Start chest compressions | चेस्ट कंप्रेशन शुरू करें
e: Chest compressions are indicated if the heart rate remains below 60 bpm after 30 seconds of effective ventilation.

qe: What is 'Menorrhagia' clinically defined as?
qh: 'मेनोरेजिया' (Menorrhagia) को चिकित्सकीय रूप से क्या कहा जाता है?
o: Excessive or prolonged menstrual bleeding | अत्यधिक या लंबा मासिक धर्म
e: It refers to abnormally heavy or prolonged bleeding that interferes with the woman's quality of life.

qe: What is the primary symptom of 'Uterine Fibroids'?
qh: 'गर्भाशय फाइब्रॉइड' (Uterine Fibroids) का प्राथमिक लक्षण क्या है?
o: Abnormal uterine bleeding and pelvic pressure | असामान्य रक्तस्राव
e: Fibroids are non-cancerous growths that often cause heavy periods and pelvic pain. Other symptoms are pain in the back, pressure on the bladder and a feeling of fullness in the lower abdomen.

qe: In 'Vesico-Vaginal Fistula' (VVF), there is an abnormal opening between:
qh: 'वेसिको-वैजाइनल फिस्टुला' (VVF) में किसके बीच एक असामान्य छेद होता है?
o: Bladder and Vagina | मूत्राशय और योनि
e: VVF causes continuous involuntary leakage of urine into the vagina. It commonly follows a prolonged or obstructed labour, when the tissues are crushed between the head and the pelvis.

qe: What is the most common cause of 'Vaginal Fistula' in developing countries?
qh: विकासशील देशों में 'वैजाइनल फिस्टुला' का सबसे सामान्य कारण क्या है?
e: Prolonged pressure of the fetal head against the mother's tissues during obstructed labour causes tissue death and fistula.

qe: Which nursing intervention is crucial for a patient with VVF?
qh: VVF वाले रोगी के लिए कौन सा नर्सिंग हस्तक्षेप महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: Skin care and preventing excoriation due to urine | त्वचा की देखभाल
e: Constant urine leakage can cause severe skin breakdown and emotional distress; hygiene is priority.

qe: What is 'Secondary Amenorrhea'?
qh: 'सेकेंडरी अमेनोरिया' (Secondary Amenorrhea) क्या है?
o: Absence of periods for 6 months in a woman who previously had them | मासिक धर्म का बंद होना
e: It can be caused by pregnancy, stress, weight loss, or hormonal disorders like PCOS. It means the periods stop for six months or more in a woman who had regular cycles earlier.

qe: Which symptom is a common 'Menopausal' vasomotor symptom?
qh: कौन सा लक्षण एक सामान्य 'रजोनिवृत्ति' (Menopausal) वासोमोटर लक्षण है?
o: Hot flashes and night sweats | हॉट फ्लैशेस
e: Declining estrogen levels lead to sudden feelings of heat and sweating. The woman may also have flushing of the face, night sweats and disturbed sleep.

qe: What is an 'Ovarian Cyst'?
qh: 'ओवेरियन सिस्ट' (Ovarian Cyst) क्या है?
o: A fluid-filled sac on the ovary | अंडाशय पर तरल से भरी थैली
e: Most cysts are functional and harmless, but some can cause pain or require surgery. It is a fluid-filled sac in the ovary, and it may cause a dull pain or a feeling of heaviness.

qe: In 'Recto-Vaginal Fistula' (RVF), what is the characteristic symptom?
qh: 'रेक्टो-वैजाइनल फिस्टुला' (RVF) में विशिष्ट लक्षण क्या है?
o: Passage of gas or feces through the vagina | योनि से मल का निकलना
e: RVF involves an opening between the rectum and the vagina, leading to fecal incontinence via the vagina.

qe: What is the primary treatment for 'Large' uterine fibroids causing severe symptoms?
qh: गंभीर लक्षण पैदा करने वाले 'बड़े' गर्भाशय फाइब्रॉइड का प्राथमिक उपचार क्या है?
o: Myomectomy or Hysterectomy | मायोमेक्टोमी या हिस्टेरेक्टॉमी
e: Surgical removal of the fibroid (myomectomy) or the entire uterus (hysterectomy) may be necessary.

qe: What is the nurse's priority assessment immediately after a 'C-Section' (Caesarean)?
qh: 'C-Section' के तुरंत बाद नर्स की प्राथमिकता क्या है?
o: Uterine firmness and vaginal bleeding (Lochia) | गर्भाशय की मजबूती और रक्तस्राव
e: Post-op monitoring for hemorrhage and uterine atony is critical after a Caesarean delivery.

qe: In 'Forceps Delivery', which maternal complication is a nurse most alert for?
qh: 'फोरसेप्स डिलीवरी' में नर्स किस जटिलता के लिए सबसे अधिक सतर्क रहती है?
o: Perineal and vaginal lacerations | पेरिनियम और योनि में चोट
e: Forceps can cause significant soft tissue trauma or tears to the mother's birth canal. The nurse should watch for bleeding, tears of the perineum or cervix and injury to the bladder.

qe: Why is it essential to examine the 'Placenta' after delivery?
qh: प्रसव के बाद 'प्लेसेंटा' की जांच करना क्यों आवश्यक है?
o: To ensure no fragments are left inside (preventing PPH) | कोई टुकड़ा अंदर न बचा हो
e: Retained placental fragments can prevent uterine contraction, leading to severe Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH).

qe: Which clinical sign indicates 'Vacuum Extraction' may have caused a scalp injury to the neonate?
qh: कौन सा नैदानिक संकेत बताता है कि 'वैक्यूम एक्सट्रैक्शन' से नवजात के सिर पर चोट लगी है?
o: Chignon or Caput Succedaneum | चिग्नॉन या कपूत सक्सीडेनियम
e: Vacuum extraction often causes a localized swelling (chignon) on the baby's head where the suction cup was applied.

qe: A nurse is caring for a post-C-section patient. Which symptom should be reported as a possible 'Infection'?
qh: C-section के बाद किस लक्षण को संभावित 'संक्रमण' के रूप में रिपोर्ट किया जाना चाहिए?
o: Foul-smelling lochia and high fever | दुर्गंधयुक्त लोचिया और तेज बुखार
e: These are classic signs of endometritis or wound infection following surgery. A rising temperature, foul-smelling discharge, pain in the lower abdomen and a red tender wound point to infection.

qe: What is the primary indication for using 'Vacuum' or 'Forceps' during labour?
qh: प्रसव के दौरान 'वैक्यूम' या 'फोरसेप्स' का उपयोग करने का प्राथमिक संकेत क्या है?
o: Prolonged second stage or fetal distress | प्रसव का लंबा दूसरा चरण
e: These tools are used to assist delivery when the mother is exhausted or the baby needs immediate birth.

qe: After a C-section, the nurse must encourage early 'Ambulation' to prevent:
qh: C-section के बाद, नर्स को किसकी रोकथाम के लिए 'एम्बुलेशन' (चलना-फिरना) को बढ़ावा देना चाहिए?
e: Early movement improves circulation and prevents blood clots in the legs after surgery. Early movement also helps the bowels and the lungs to recover and prevents pneumonia and constipation.

qe: How many 'Vessels' should a normal Umbilical Cord have during examination?
qh: जांच के दौरान एक सामान्य गर्भनाल में कितनी 'वाहिकाएं' (Vessels) होनी चाहिए?
o: Two arteries, one vein | दो धमनियां, एक शिरा
e: Presence of only two vessels (one artery, one vein) may indicate congenital anomalies. A normal cord has two arteries and one vein, and a single artery means the baby should be examined for other defects.

qe: What is 'Retained Placenta'?
qh: 'रिटेंड प्लेसेंटा' (Retained Placenta) क्या है?
o: Placenta not delivered within 30 mins after birth | 30 मिनट तक प्लेसेंटा न निकलना
e: It is a complication that often requires manual removal under anesthesia. The placenta is not delivered even half an hour after the birth, and it may cause heavy bleeding or infection.

qe: Which nerve injury can occur to the newborn in a difficult Forceps delivery?
qh: एक कठिन फोरसेप्स डिलीवरी में नवजात शिशु को कौन सी तंत्रिका क्षति हो सकती है?
o: Facial nerve | चेहरे की तंत्रिका (Facial nerve)
e: Pressure from the forceps blades can cause temporary or permanent facial palsy in the neonate.

qe: What is 'Precipitate Labour'?
qh: 'प्रेसिपिटेट लेबर' (Precipitate Labour) क्या है?
o: Labour lasting less than 3 hours | 3 घंटे से कम समय का प्रसव
e: Rapid delivery increases the risk of maternal lacerations and fetal intracranial hemorrhage.

qe: Which manoeuvre is used to deliver the head in a 'Breech' presentation?
qh: 'ब्रीच' प्रेजेंटेशन में सिर निकालने के लिए किस पैंतरे (manoeuvre) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: This specific technique helps in the safe delivery of the after-coming head in breech births.

qe: What is 'Lochia Serosa'?
qh: 'लोचिया सेरोसा' (Lochia Serosa) क्या है?
e: It follows lochia rubra and contains serum, leukocytes, and tissue debris. It appears about three to ten days after delivery, is pinkish brown in colour and is serous in nature.

qe: Which vitamin is essential for the prevention of 'Neural Tube Defects' (NTD)?
qh: 'न्यूरल ट्यूब डिफेक्ट' (NTD) की रोकथाम के लिए कौन सा विटामिन आवश्यक है?
e: Folic acid supplementation is recommended before and during early pregnancy to prevent NTDs like spina bifida.

qe: What is 'Mastitis'?
qh: 'मास्टिटिस' (Mastitis) क्या है?
o: Inflammation/infection of the breast tissue | स्तन ऊतक की सूजन
e: It often occurs during breastfeeding due to a blocked duct or bacteria entering via a cracked nipple.

qe: Which clinical sign indicates 'Atonic' Postpartum Hemorrhage?
qh: 'एटोनिक' प्रसवोत्तर रक्तस्राव का कौन सा नैदानिक संकेत है?
o: Soft, boggy uterus | नरम और ढीला गर्भाशय
e: A soft or boggy uterus fails to compress blood vessels after placental delivery, leading to heavy bleeding.

qe: The surgical removal of the 'Uterus' is called:
qh: 'गर्भाशय' को शल्य चिकित्सा द्वारा निकालने को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Hysterectomy can be total or partial depending on the condition (fibroids, cancer, etc.). When the operation is done for cancer or a large growth, the ovaries and the tubes may also be removed.

qe: What is 'Dysmenorrhea'?
qh: 'डिस्मेनोरिया' (Dysmenorrhea) क्या है?
e: It is characterized by cramping pain in the lower abdomen during or before menstruation. It may be primary, caused by prostaglandins, or secondary to fibroids or endometriosis.

qe: Which family planning method is a 'Hormonal' injectable?
qh: परिवार नियोजन की कौन सी विधि 'हार्मोनल' इंजेक्शन है?
e: DMPA is an injectable contraceptive given every 3 months. The injection is given deep into the muscle, and one dose gives protection for about three months.

qe: What is 'Cervical Erosion'?
qh: 'सर्वाइकल इरोजन' (Cervical Erosion) क्या है?
o: Columnar epithelium replaces squamous epithelium on the cervix | गर्भाशय ग्रीवा का घाव
e: It often appears as a red, velvety area on the cervix and can cause vaginal discharge or spotting.

qe: What is the primary characteristic of 'Placenta Previa'?
qh: 'प्लेसेंटा प्रीविया' (Placenta Previa) की प्राथमिक विशेषता क्या है?
o: Painless, bright red vaginal bleeding in late pregnancy | दर्द रहित रक्तस्राव
e: In Placenta Previa, the placenta is implanted in the lower uterine segment, causing painless bleeding when the cervix dilates.

qe: Which condition involves the premature separation of a normally implanted placenta?
qh: सामान्य रूप से आरोपित प्लेसेंटा के समय से पहले अलग होने की स्थिति को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Abruptio placentae is a medical emergency characterized by painful bleeding and uterine tenderness.

qe: What is the drug of choice for 'Syphilis' during pregnancy?
qh: गर्भावस्था के दौरान 'सिफलिस' के लिए पहली पसंद की दवा कौन सी है?
e: Penicillin is effective in treating maternal syphilis and preventing congenital syphilis in the fetus.

qe: A pregnancy that occurs outside the uterine cavity is known as:
qh: गर्भाशय गुहा के बाहर होने वाली गर्भावस्था को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Most ectopic pregnancies occur in the fallopian tubes and can lead to life-threatening rupture.

qe: What is 'Polyhydramnios'?
qh: 'पॉलीहाइड्रामनियोस' (Polyhydramnios) क्या है?
o: Excessive amniotic fluid (more than 2000ml) | अत्यधिक एमनियोटिक द्रव
e: Excessive fluid can lead to complications like preterm labour and cord prolapse. It means more than the normal amount of amniotic fluid, and it is often seen in diabetes or twin pregnancy.

qe: Which test is used to screen for 'Gestational Diabetes Mellitus' (GDM)?
qh: 'जेस्टेशनल डायबिटीज' के लिए किस परीक्षण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: OGTT measures the body's ability to handle glucose during pregnancy. The woman drinks a glucose solution on an empty stomach, and the blood is tested at fixed intervals.

qe: What is the primary risk for a baby born to a 'Diabetic' mother?
qh: 'मधुमेह' वाली माँ से पैदा हुए बच्चे के लिए प्राथमिक जोखिम क्या है?
e: High maternal glucose causes the fetal pancreas to produce excess insulin, leading to low blood sugar after birth.

qe: In 'Hyperemesis Gravidarum', the nurse's priority is:
qh: 'हाइपरमेसिस ग्रेविडरम' में नर्स की प्राथमिकता क्या है?
o: Fluid and electrolyte replacement | तरल और इलेक्ट्रोलाइट प्रतिस्थापन
e: Severe vomiting leads to dehydration and ketosis, requiring IV fluids. The priority is to stop the vomiting, replace the fluids and salts by the intravenous route and correct the ketosis.

qe: Which infection is a part of the 'TORCH' screening in pregnancy?
qh: गर्भावस्था में 'TORCH' स्क्रीनिंग में कौन सा संक्रमण शामिल है?
e: TORCH stands for Toxoplasmosis, Other (Syphilis, etc.), Rubella, Cytomegalovirus, and Herpes.

qe: What does a 'Bishop Score' assess?
qh: 'बिशप स्कोर' (Bishop Score) क्या मापता है?
o: Readiness of the cervix for induction of labour | प्रसव प्रेरण के लिए तैयारी
e: It evaluates cervical dilation, effacement, consistency, position, and fetal station. A higher score means the cervix is ripe and ready for induction of labour.

qe: What is the duration of the 'Puerperium' period?
qh: 'प्यूपेरियम' (Puerperium) अवधि की अवधि क्या है?
e: It is the period (approx 42 days) following childbirth during which the mother's organs return to their non-pregnant state.

qe: Which hormone is primarily responsible for 'Milk Ejection' (let-down reflex)?
qh: 'दूध के स्राव' के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा हार्मोन जिम्मेदार है?
e: Oxytocin causes the contraction of myoepithelial cells in the breast, ejecting milk; Prolactin stimulates production.

qe: What is 'Lochia Rubra'?
qh: 'लोचिया रूब्रा' (Lochia Rubra) क्या है?
o: Bright red vaginal discharge for first 1-3 days post-delivery | लाल रंग का स्राव
e: It consists primarily of blood and decidual debris, appearing immediately after delivery. It lasts for the first three or four days after birth and is bright red in colour.

qe: The first milk produced after birth, rich in antibodies, is called:
qh: जन्म के बाद उत्पादित पहला दूध, जो एंटीबॉडी से भरपूर होता है, कहलाता है:
e: Colostrum is essential for providing natural immunity to the newborn. It is thick and yellowish, and it also cleans the baby's gut and protects it from infection.

qe: What is the most common cause of 'Postpartum Hemorrhage' (PPH)?
qh: 'प्रसवोत्तर रक्तस्राव' (PPH) का सबसे सामान्य कारण क्या है?
e: Uterine atony (failure of the uterus to contract after delivery) accounts for 80% of PPH cases.

qe: Which family planning method is considered 'Permanent' for males?
qh: पुरुषों के लिए परिवार नियोजन की कौन सी विधि 'स्थायी' मानी जाती है?
e: Vasectomy involves cutting or sealing the vas deferens to prevent sperm from entering the semen.

qe: What does 'Exclusive Breastfeeding' mean?
qh: 'एक्सक्लूसिव ब्रेस्टफीडिंग' का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Only breast milk for first 6 months | केवल स्तनपान
e: The infant receives only breast milk (no water or other foods) for the first six months of life.

qe: What is 'Involution' of the uterus?
qh: गर्भाशय का 'इनवोल्यूशन' (Involution) क्या है?
o: Uterus returning to its normal size post-delivery | सामान्य आकार में लौटना
e: This process is facilitated by oxytocin release during breastfeeding. The uterus returns to its normal size in about six weeks, and the process is helped by breastfeeding.

qe: Which family planning method also provides protection against STIs?
qh: परिवार नियोजन की कौन सी विधि STI से भी सुरक्षा प्रदान करती है?
e: Barrier methods like condoms are the only ones providing dual protection against pregnancy and infections.

qe: What is a primary nursing instruction for a mother with 'Engorged' breasts?
qh: 'भारी' (Engorged) स्तनों वाली माँ के लिए प्राथमिक नर्सिंग निर्देश क्या है?
o: Frequent feeding and warm compresses | बार-बार स्तनपान
e: Regular emptying of the breasts through feeding or expression is the best way to relieve engorgement.

qe: Which sign is considered a 'Positive' sign of pregnancy?
qh: गर्भावस्था का 'सकारात्मक' (Positive) संकेत कौन सा माना जाता है?
o: Fetal heart sounds heard by doppler | भ्रूण के दिल की धड़कन
e: Fetal heart sounds and ultrasound visualization are definitive (positive) signs, unlike presumptive signs like nausea.

qe: What is the primary characteristic of 'Eclampsia' that distinguishes it from Pre-eclampsia?
qh: 'एक्लेम्पसिया' (Eclampsia) की प्राथमिक विशेषता क्या है जो इसे प्री-एक्लेम्पसिया से अलग करती है?
e: The onset of seizures in a woman with pre-eclampsia marks the transition to eclampsia, a life-threatening emergency.

qe: In the first stage of labour, what is the main physiological change?
qh: प्रसव के पहले चरण में मुख्य शारीरिक परिवर्तन क्या होता है?
o: Progressive dilation and effacement of the cervix | गर्भाशय ग्रीवा का विस्तार
e: The first stage begins with regular contractions and ends with full cervical dilation (10 cm).

qe: What is 'Naegele’s Rule' used for?
qh: 'नेगेल्स रूल' (Naegele’s Rule) का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: To calculate the Expected Date of Delivery (EDD) | ईडीडी की गणना
e: EDD is calculated by adding 9 months and 7 days to the first day of the Last Menstrual Period (LMP).

qe: Which position is recommended for a pregnant woman to prevent 'Supine Hypotension Syndrome'?
qh: 'सुपाइन हाइपोटेंशन सिंड्रोम' को रोकने के लिए गर्भवती महिला के लिए कौन सी स्थिति अनुशंसित है?
e: The left lateral position removes pressure from the inferior vena cava, improving blood flow to the heart and fetus.

qe: What is 'Episiotomy'?
qh: 'एपिसियोटॉमी' (Episiotomy) क्या है?
o: Surgical incision of the perineum to enlarge vaginal opening | पेरिनियम में चीरा
e: It is often performed during the second stage of labour to prevent jagged tears and facilitate delivery.

qe: Which medication is the drug of choice for managing seizures in Eclampsia?
qh: एक्लेम्पसिया में दौरे के प्रबंधन के लिए कौन सी दवा पहली पसंद है?
e: Magnesium Sulfate is highly effective in preventing and treating eclamptic seizures. It is given intravenously or as a deep intramuscular injection, and the nurse watches the reflexes, the respiratory rate and the urine output.

qe: The 'Second Stage' of labour ends with:
qh: प्रसव का 'दूसरा चरण' किसके साथ समाप्त होता है?
o: Birth of the baby | बच्चे का जन्म
